key_concepts: Speed is distance traveled divided by time
Velocity is displacement divided by time with direction
Average speed is total distance divided by total time
Average velocity is total displacement divided by total time
Speed units include meters per second and kilometers per hour
Displacement is straight-line distance in a given direction
Time can be calculated from distance and speed
Displacement can be calculated from velocity and time
Measuring speed requires accurate distance and time data
Average speed may differ from speed at a particular distance
Direction is needed to describe velocity
Vehicle speeds can be compared with school zone speed limits
